typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ReportName as string ('pfoxd105d vSphere World'),
	datastoreallocation_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Name as string,
		{Interval Breakdown} as string,
		DataCenter as string,
		{Total Capacity} as string,
		{Total Provisioned} as string,
		{Free Space} as string,
		Overhead as string,
		{Datastore Status} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> DataStoreAllocation0
DataStoreAllocation0 derive(report_name = toString($ReportName),
		importdate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		DataCenter as string,
		Total_Provisioned as string,
		Total_Capacity as string,
		Overhead as string,
		Interval_Breakdown as string,
		Datastore_Status as string,
		report_name as string,
		Name as string,
		Free_Space as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DataCenter,
		Total_Provisioned = {Total Provisioned},
		Total_Capacity = {Total Capacity},
		Overhead,
		Interval_Breakdown = {Interval Breakdown},
		Datastore_Status = {Datastore Status},
		report_name,
		Name,
		Free_Space = {Free Space}),
	partitionFileNames:[($datastoreallocation_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> datastoreallocation
